instruction: Studio photograph, full shot. In an indoor studio with draped beige curtains, a shirtless man in black pants (R2) stands facing forward, supporting a woman in a beige sports bra and black shorts (R1). The woman balances in a side-lying split pose, her left leg extended horizontally and her right leg bent. The shirtless man holds her left thigh with his right hand and her raised left hand with his left hand. No bystanders are present. Soft studio lighting highlights their muscles against the neutral background.
